email_body:
Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing & Communications Operations Lead position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of fostering entrepreneurship in Belgium.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and AI-driven optimization to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This experience has made me proficient in tools like Canva, Mailchimp, and Google Analytics, and I am eager to apply my skills to streamline your communication workflows.

I am particularly drawn to the hybrid nature of this role, combining storytelling with efficiency. I am comfortable with automation tools like Zapier and Make, and I am keen to leverage AI to handle repetitive tasks, allowing more time for strategic initiatives. My organizational skills and ability to work autonomously make me a strong fit for your fast-paced environment.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Pulse Foundation's impact. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing & Communications Operations Lead position at Pulse Foundation. As a digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and AI-driven optimization, I am drawn to the opportunity to blend storytelling with operational efficiency to amplify the impact of your programs like BEyond, Revival Belgium, and Fuckup Nights.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in on-page SEO, content creation, and WordPress site management. I have successfully improved organic visibility for client websites through keyword research and technical audits. My experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs has enabled me to make data-driven decisions to refine strategies. Additionally, I have hands-on experience with Canva, Mailchimp, and Google Ads, which are essential for managing campaigns and newsletters.

What sets me apart is my proactive approach to leveraging AI and automation. On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am comfortable using automation tools like Zapier and Make to streamline workflows, and I am eager to apply these skills to eliminate low-value tasks and free up time for high-impact strategic work.

I am highly organized, able to work autonomously, and thrive in fast-paced environments. My background includes managing multiple projects simultaneously, and I am confident in my ability to mentor interns and oversee their onboarding. While my Dutch is at B1 level, I am actively improving it, and I am fluent in English.

I am inspired by Pulse Foundation's mission to foster entrepreneurship and would be thrilled to contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your communication strategy and operational efficiency.

Sincerely,
